ICS 23.140MED 22Revised Standard from Last Update.1. SCOPEThis standard provides general guidance on air receivers for compressed air installations, where design pressure does not exceed 25 bar.2. REFERENCESThe standards listed below contain provisions which through reference in this text, constitute provisions of this standard. At the time of publication, the editions indicated were valid. All standards are subject to revision and parties to agreement based on this standard are encouraged to investigate the possibility of applying the most recent editions of the standards indicated below:IS 2002 : 2009 Steel plate for pressure vessel for intermediate and high temperature service including boilers (third revision)IS 2825 : 1969 Code for unfired pressure vesselsIS 3624 : 1987 Specification for pressure and vacuum gauges (second revision)
